scenarios.title: Useful health supply and authoritative return
prerequisites: Use native session on existing Meridian; record actual config, actor ID, maxHealth and pickup ID at x=-6,z=22 with source-derived floor y
Obtain nonlethal damage via DAMAGE; stop incoming fire; pickup wait must be zero
actions: Click to capture pointer, use mouse and WASD to walk within 3D distance <1.05 of health pickup; do not press E for collection
Leave the radius immediately after collection; observe at least 12 seconds of authority simulation time with no competing collector
Return at full health for negative usefulness check only if health is actually maxHealth
authority: On useful collection health becomes min(maxHealth,previousHealth+35); pickup event actor/kind and wait=12 before elapsed ticks
wait decreases to zero in active simulation; full-health contact does not consume health pickup
native: HUD health follows snapshot; marker hides while wait>0 and reappears at wait<=0
Do not expect a collection sound or kind-specific model from diagnostic implementation
capture: Bounded snapshots before/after contact and return with seq,time,actor health,maxHealth and pickup id/position/wait
Pickup event ID, actor and kind; screen images at available/hidden/returned states; input timestamps
scenarios.pass_criteria: All expected authority and native transitions observed for same pickup ID; return follows authority, not a local timer.
scenarios.fail_criteria: Useful contact without transition, incorrect health cap, hidden available marker or visible unavailable marker; contested pickup or missed snapshots makes run inconclusive, not pass.
questions: Walkable approach from actual spawn to (-6,22) needs live route confirmation; use authored corridors, not teleportation

scenarios.title: Weapon supply consumption and inventory
prerequisites: Record starting weapon/ammo and loadout; rocket pickup x=-14,z=-19 must exist, be allowed and useful
actions: Walk using WASD and mouse through rocket supply radius <1.05
Leave pickup radius and observe authority return after 15 simulation seconds
authority: Ammo increases by weapon magazine plus Tool Use reload bonus capped at cap (or infinity under unlimitedAmmo)
If previous weapon=0 and not armsrace, selected weapon becomes rocket index 1; pickup wait becomes 15 and pickup event emitted
native: Snapshot weapon/ammo shown in HUD; marker hidden until wait<=0
capture: Before/after ammo,weapon,verbState,config and pickup ID/wait; pickup event and screen image
scenarios.pass_criteria: Inventory matches actual loadout rules and marker follows wait; no requirement for absent weapon-switch key.
scenarios.fail_criteria: Client invents inventory or respawns marker before authoritative availability.
questions: Confirm actual route into departure hall and current loadout ammo cap before session

scenarios.title: Intentional nonlethal damage and feedback
prerequisites: Record config, victim/source IDs, positions, health,armor,temporaryShield,juggernautShield,verbState and protection
Wait until protection=0; use ordinary deathmatch without mutators for baseline

Arrange visible opponent at an existing clear lane; controlled second-human native join path requires primary-agent investigation (current session creates its own room); bots make exact damage attribution harder
actions: Aim with mouse and briefly hold left click; victim stops moving; stop fire while victim remains alive
Repeat from cover as a negative line-of-sight observation only after verifying weapon behavior
authority: Successful damage event identifies victim actor and source; amount includes absorbed damage, not merely HP lost
Shield stages precede armor; armor absorbs min(armor,remainingDamage*0.6), remainder reduces health, floored at zero
native: Victim HUD follows health/armor snapshot; positive damage event shows TAKING DAMAGE locally
Source shows HIT CONFIRMED only for positive damage to another actor; shot alone is not hit confirmation
capture: Events shot and damage with event IDs; source/victim snapshots; weapon and distance; HUD images on both clients if available
scenarios.pass_criteria: Nonlethal authority changes reconcile with modifiers and feedback belongs to correct actor.
scenarios.fail_criteria: Hit label from shot without damage, wrong-actor hurt, or unexplained state mismatch; unknown modifiers mean inconclusive numeric comparison.
questions: Human join/aim setup needs primary-agent support; do not modify runtime in this audit

scenarios.title: Lethal hit followed by automatic respawn
prerequisites: Keep round below frag/time end conditions; record respawn config and identity mapping
Resolve DAMAGE setup and wait for protection to expire
actions: Continue supported left-click fire until victim health reaches zero; then stop firing
Victim attempts WASD and fire while dead; wait without pressing a respawn button
After authority spawn, move and aim again; click to capture if pointer was released
authority: Death increments deaths, sets health=0 and dead=respawnDelay; normal opponent kill increments source frags and emits death
Active simulation decrements dead; spawn restores health/loadout, dead=0, protection=1.5 and emits spawn for same actor ID; spawn location is server-selected
native: DEAD label uses snapshot timer; controls neutral while dead, remote victim hidden
On alive snapshot camera uses source spawn position/look, controls resume and remote body returns; results override dead if round ended
capture: Continuous bounded snapshot window alive->dead->alive with actor id,health,dead,position,yaw,pitch,protection,deaths,ammo
Death/spawn event IDs and round boundaries; victim control frames during dead period; before/dead/respawn screenshots
scenarios.pass_criteria: Complete same-round same-actor lifecycle observed, no client countdown authority and no movement/fire authority while dead.
scenarios.fail_criteria: Client respawns early, retains prior pose after spawn or sends active dead controls; missing dead snapshot is inconclusive, not evidence of correct transition.
questions: Sparse existing capture cannot verify this complete snapshot sequence
Investigate health=0 with dead<=0 snapshots and mode-specific retained dead actors before broadening acceptance

scenarios.title: Lethal round-ending kill does not trigger automatic next round
prerequisites: Use existing actual frag limit; reach one frag below limit through legitimate play; do not change rules to simplify test
actions: Perform final legal kill; wait beyond configured respawn delay
Press Enter only after results, then observe authority start and fresh state
authority: endMatch sets over; subsequent step returns before decrementing timers or spawning
Restart is a requested start accepted by server, not death timer expiration
native: RESULTS gates controls and releases pointer; clear previous round presentation on start
Fresh snapshot reseeds local pose; do not equate reused IDs in a new round with same-round respawn
capture: Last damage/death, results.state.over, start and first fresh snapshot; pointer/control observations
scenarios.pass_criteria: No auto-respawn during results and new round begins only through server accepted start.
scenarios.fail_criteria: Dead timer overrides results or previous-round markers/feedback persist after start.
questions: Normal-rate manual evidence is pending; existing lifecycle smoke covers round restart, not intentional lethal transition
